goal.statement: Re-establish the composite-laminate verification of the TensorFEM plate/3-D elasticity/CLT stack on this work tree, score it against external quantitative anchors (Pagano 3-D elasticity, Cook 1974 membrane) and close the open experiment with an artifact ledger plus a paper-grade report.
anchors: Pagano (1970) layered 3-D elasticity (propagator solution, exact for specially orthotropic plies)
CLT/Fourier series solution (truncated Navier basis, D16/D26 retained)
Richardson extrapolated 3-D HEX20 sequence (angle-ply cases without a closed-form anchor)

criteria.C1_completeness: >=3 layups x >=3 thickness ratios x >=3 meshes per FE path, every case reported
criteria.C2_deflection_vs_anchor: |centre deflection deviation| < 3.0% for t/a <= 0.1 and < 5.0% for t/a = 0.5, both FE paths vs the case anchor
criteria.C3_grid_convergence: Roache GCI at the finest level < 5.0% and observed order within 50% of the theoretical order
criteria.C4_interlaminar_shear: tau_xz at the ply interfaces within 10.0% of the Pagano 3-D elasticity anchor
criteria.C5_cook_membrane_shear_anchor: Cook (1974) membrane tip deflection within 3.0% of 23.96 on the finest Q4 mesh
criteria.D1_failure_diagnosis: diagnostic only (no verdict weight): for every case whose finest mesh misses the deflection band, Richardson-extrapolate each FE path and classify the cause as under_resolved (the extrapolated value passes) or systematic_bias (it does not)
criteria.D2_plate_path_probe: diagnostic only (no verdict weight): isotropic single-ply controls decide whether the plate-path bias is an element defect or specific to the layered sections
criteria.D3_plate_vs_fsdt_theory: diagnostic only (no verdict weight): compare the Q4 plate path with the FSDT (Mindlin) Navier closed form, which is the model the plate element implements; agreement here means a deflection deviation against a 3-D anchor is a model limitation, not an implementation defect

C3_grid_convergence.criterion: Roache GCI at the finest level < 5.0% and observed order within 50% of the theoretical order

C4_interlaminar_shear.criterion: tau_xz at the ply interfaces within 10.0% of the Pagano 3-D elasticity anchor

D1_failure_diagnosis.criterion: diagnostic only (no verdict weight): for every case whose finest mesh misses the deflection band, Richardson-extrapolate each FE path and classify the cause as under_resolved (the extrapolated value passes) or systematic_bias (it does not)

D2_plate_path_probe.criterion: diagnostic only (no verdict weight): isotropic single-ply controls decide whether the plate-path bias is an element defect or specific to the layered sections
D2_plate_path_probe.probe: isotropic single-ply plate, E = 70 GPa, nu = 0.3, SS1, q = q0 sin(pi x/a) sin(pi y/a)
D2_plate_path_probe.interpretation: the Q4 Mindlin plate FE reproduces the isotropic closed form, so the W26 plate-path deviations are specific to the layered cases

D3_plate_vs_fsdt_theory.criterion: diagnostic only (no verdict weight): compare the Q4 plate path with the FSDT (Mindlin) Navier closed form, which is the model the plate element implements; agreement here means a deflection deviation against a 3-D anchor is a model limitation, not an implementation defect
D3_plate_vs_fsdt_theory.conclusion: the FSDT anchor absorbs most of the FE-vs-CLT gap for the shear-soft layups at a/h = 10, so the gap is transverse shear deformation and the Kirchhoff anchor is outside its validity domain there

provenance.load: q = q0 sin(pi x / a) sin(pi y / b), SS1 (shear diaphragm) edges

honesty.zero_hand_copy: every numeric field is read from an artifact written by a solver call; provenance carries sha256 of each artifact and of the producing modules
honesty.honest_fail_preserved: criterion verdicts are computed, never overridden; WITHHELD marks cases without a closed-form anchor
scope_limits: the Pagano state-space anchor exists only for specially orthotropic layups, so angle-ply interlaminar shear stays WITHHELD
all cases are SS1 square plates under a single sine load, h/a from 0.01 to 0.5; first-ply-failure / delamination growth are out of scope
